semantics.feasible: displayed spanning rational vectors annihilate every nonedge tensor and give tensor rank binom(r+1,2)-1
semantics.infeasible: displayed independent set has r+1 vertices, forcing r+1 nonzero mutually orthogonal vectors in Q^r or R^r
semantics.scope_excludes: edge positivity and path-derivative KKT compatibility
semantics.unresolved: neither conclusion; bounded exact witness search is not an infeasibility certificate
